REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

items.lawCode: Add §629-a, Tax L; amd §95-e, St Fin L
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S325

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the tax law and the state finance law, in relation to
establishing a gift for the autism awareness and research fund


 PURPOSE :
To establish a New York State income tax check off to support the gift
for the Autism Awareness and Research Fund.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
The tax law is amended by adding a new section 629-a which creates a
gift for the autism awareness and research fund.

Subdivision 2 of section 95-e of the state finance law, as added by
chapter 301 of the laws of 2004, is amended to read as follows:

Such fund shall consist of all revenues received pursuant to the
provisions of section 404-v of the vehicle and traffic law, section
629-a of the tax law, and all other moneys appropriated, credited, or
transferred thereto from any other fund or source pursuant to law.

 JUSTIFICATION :
Recent studies have indicated that 1 out of every 150 people is now
diagnosed somewhere on the autistic spectrum. Autism impacts the lives
of those with the disorder as well as their families. The funding for
autism research is becoming increasingly important and necessary.

Autism occurs in approximately five to fifteen per 10,000 births and
the cause is still unknown. Those who suffer with autism may have
communication problems; difficulty in relating to people, objects and
events; unusual play with toys and other objects; difficulty with
changes in routine or familiar surroundings; and repetitive body
movements or behavior patterns. Early diagnosis and appropriate
educational programs are very important to children with autism.

This legislation would establish a New York State income tax check off
to support the gift for the Autism Awareness and Research Fund. The
Autism Awareness and Research Fund educates families to help provide
for long term care, job training and other need which require funding.

Individuals without the economic means to afford necessary education
and treatment for these children who are diagnosed will benefit from
this legislation.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
2007/08: S.4910 Investigations and Government Operations; A.10678 Ways
& Means

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
To be determined.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Establishes a gift for the autism awareness and research fund on the personal income tax form.
